sentences.en: If I had known his address, I would have written.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道他的地址，我就会写信了。

sentences.en: Had he known the truth, he would have told me.
sentences.zh: 他要是知道真相的话，早就告诉我了。

sentences.en: Had I known about it, I would have told you.
sentences.zh: 如果我知道这件事，我就告诉你了。

senses.zh: 大家知道的；已知的；知名的
